source_review.scope: UI-only adapters; no native read/write carrier or App integration
adapter_requirements: Caller supplies current authorized scoped metadata and bodies and immediately clears revoked scope.
Caller replaces authorizedReadToken only after a fresh successful authorized read; required onAccessChanged must invalidate parent context.
Caller owns actual transport/session checks, frozen prepared request creation and receipt correlation; throws or uncorrelated outcomes remain unknown.
Eligibility is an explicit closed native decision bound to current scope/session/head/result/epoch/generation; current unavailable Before adds no client authority restriction.
onDraftState is required, scoped and same-session only; exact unknown prepared request must survive temporary loading/access transitions.

source_map.body_integrity: verifyDocReviewBody: exact target base/selected output hashes, scope/session/result pins, UTF8 <=32768, no CR/NUL/lone surrogates
source_map.comparison: boundedDocDiff: <=400 lines each, <=40000 matrix cells, exact source reconstruction and final-newline indicators; explicit unavailable fallback
source_map.state: per-action retained pins and notes; explicit adoption; monotonic view/client/session/authorized-read generation; exact prepared retry; denied fence retained across remount
source_map.presentation: After default, Changes/Before/After/Source, independent review vs accountable acceptance copy, prior output read-only, scoped20rowlist, pending/conflict/unknown/unsupported/offline/revoked states

source_review.reviewer: integrator reviewed body integrity, bounded diff, exact prepared retry, monotonic scope/session fences and access-denial persistence
